races.title: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MOMENTS AWAY matched the form of his hurdling debut second despite seeming to find the emphasis on speed against him when fifth in what was a stronger affair at Newbury (2m) 2 weeks ago. The return to further looks firmly in his favour and Martin Keighley's charge looks the way to go with the prospect of more to come. I've Got A Friend has made a very bright start to his career and rates next best over penalised Nightflyer . MOMENTS AWAY (IRE) I'VE GOT A FRIEND (IRE) NIGHTFLYER (GER)

races.title: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: INEDIT D'AMOUR has encouragingly got back on track returned to chasing this autumn and again confirmed himself on a competitive mark when finding only one too good at Bangor (17f) 24 days ago. A winner over hurdles at this venue, he's selected to confirm recent promise back over this longer trip. Gaelic Rambler will appreciate the return to larger obstacles, whilst Legendary Luke is surely capable of better than he showed on return/chase debut at Ffos Las. INEDIT D'AMOUR (FR) GAELIC RAMBLER (IRE) LEGENDARY LUKE (IRE)

races.title: Support The Injured Jockeys Fund Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: JETEYE has been well placed by the shrewd Sam England team and can notch a sixth success of the year. The main danger looks to be Crafty Gael , who arrives in similarly rude health, while Speed Davis may prove best of the rest under a promising claimer. JETEYE (IRE) CRAFTY GAEL (IRE) SPEED DAVIS (FR)

races.title: racingtv.com/freetrial Female Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: ILLOGICAL LOGIC is certain to benefit from this step back up in trip and David Thompson's gelding can notch a third win for the yard. I See The Sea scored over this trip from a higher mark on the card last year, so is also worth considering, whilst Anytrixwilldo would be of some interest if able to back up his recent Huntingdon success. ILLOGICAL LOGIC (FR) I SEE THE SEA (IRE) ANYTRIXWILLDO (IRE)
